messages:
ciara: FYI customer reported streaming responses drop after long idle (~12-20s of silence then disconnect). They see partial final chunk and client reconnects which then replays a small chunk — causing duplicate tokens downstream. Repro steps attached + logs below.

alex: Customer is on Dedicated, fronted by Cloudflare -> ALB -> envoy. They only hit this with longer user think-times (long completions with pauses). Happening ~3x/day across 2 teams.

ciara: Repro steps (what I ran):
1) curl to our /v1/streams endpoint with chunked SSE header
2) send short prompt, wait 25s idle, send follow-up chunk via client reconnect
3) observe connection CLOSE from ALB then subsequent POST from client to resume and get duplicate partial tokens.

Curl: ```
curl -v -H "Accept: text/event-stream" -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" 
  https://api.redwood.example/v1/streams/chat?sse=1
```

ciara: Observed tcpdump between CF and ALB: FIN from ALB right at ~61s after last data; client side sees 502 on reconnect occasionally. ALB idle timeout seems likely but path has Cloudflare in front which may also proxy. Full packet log: ```
14:02:21.123 IP alb -> envoy FIN, seq 12345
14:02:21.124 IP client -> cf POST /resume 502
```

omar: ALB default idle timeout = 60s unless changed. Cloudflare also has a buffering layer; long idles may trigger edge resets. We had previous incidents where Cloudflare Sockets dropped long-idle SSEs. Might be double-translation of half-close between CF and ALB.

ryan: Runtime note: our SSE keepalive is only emitted when tokens produced; in many user flows there are long thinking pauses and we intentionally avoid sending padding heartbeats to save cost. That means connection could be idle for >60s.

katie: Customer asks for either (A) reliable live stream across long think-times, or (B) clear guidance for client-side reconnect/at-least-once semantics. They're worried about duplicated content when reconnect happens.

omar: Quick mitigation options: (1) emit minimal ":keepalive\n\n" SSE comment every 30s from runtime so CF/ALB see activity; (2) increase ALB idle timeout (requires infra change + may affect NLB/HA); (3) ask customer to use short polling/resume tokens (harder UX). I can try (1) as a scoped change.

ryan: Willing to add optional keepalive flag on stream handler (off by default). Need support to ensure we don't accidentally double-count tokens or change billing if we start emitting padding. Also need to make sure envoy/proxy doesn't buffer the comment (use flushes).

ciara: Customer provided sample client logs showing OnMessage duplicate 8 tokens after reconnect. They also gave request_id: req_0a9c. Attaching short excerpt below.

Client log: ```
[14:02:21] SSE closed (code 1006)
[14:02:21] reconnecting -> resumeToken=abc123
[14:02:21] resume request got 502, retrying
[14:02:22] got resumed chunk: "...the product will" (duplicate)
```

alex: Raised with customer: we'll try keepalive toggle server-side first, then follow-up with infra changes if needed. They agreed to test on a staging subdomain.

ryan: Implementation notes: add keepalive comment flush path and expose header X-Stream-Keepalive-Interval. Default off in hosted, but enable for Dedicated on request. I can draft a small PR. Also we should add e2e test that simulates CF+ALB by inserting a proxy that enforces 60s idle and verifying reconnect semantics.

omar: I'll open infra ticket to evaluate increasing ALB idle for the customer ALB pool, but that's intrusive as it affects all services behind that LB. We should prefer per-customer runtime keepalive.

devops-bot: deploy queued: runtime/keepalive-toggle branch -> staging (expected ~10m).

ciara: Action items: Ryan to PR keepalive + docs on behavior; Omar to check ALB timeout for that Dedicated zone and propose config; Alex to coordinate customer staging test; Katie to confirm SLA expectation and message to CS. I'll loop back with customer this afternoon.

ryan: PR up in 30m, I'll include flush test and unit test for not emitting keepalive when disabled.

katie: Thanks team :thumbsup: let's make sure we include sample client-side recon handling in the doc (idempotency via resume tokens).
